name: ace_search
modelDescription: MANDATORY: Search for proven coding patterns BEFORE implementing, building, fixing, or debugging. Returns battle-tested approaches, known gotchas, and best practices from the team's playbook. ALWAYS call this first when starting any coding task.
userDescription: Search ACE playbook for relevant patterns

confirmationMessages.title: Search Patterns
confirmationMessages.message: Search the ACE playbook for proven patterns related to this task before implementing.

query.description: What to search for (e.g., 'authentication', 'error handling', 'API integration')

allowed_domains.description: Comma-separated list of domains to include (whitelist). Use /domains to discover available domains.

blocked_domains.description: Comma-separated list of domains to exclude (blacklist)

task_intent.description: Task intent hint for ACE 1.5 bandit routing. Omit to use server default.

name: ace_learn
modelDescription: MANDATORY: Capture patterns from completed work. ALWAYS call this AFTER implementing features, fixing bugs, or discovering gotchas. Saves knowledge for future use - this is how the team learns and improves.
userDescription: Capture patterns and lessons learned from work

confirmationMessages.title: Capture Learning
confirmationMessages.message: Save lessons, gotchas, and patterns from this completed task to the ACE playbook.

task.description: Brief description of what was accomplished

output.description: Lessons learned, gotchas discovered, or key insights

name: ace_status
modelDescription: Show playbook statistics including total patterns, quality metrics, and section breakdown.

name: ace_get_playbook
modelDescription: Retrieve patterns from the playbook, optionally filtered by section or minimum helpful score.

section.description: Filter by section: strategies_and_hard_rules, useful_code_snippets, troubleshooting_and_pitfalls, apis_to_use
